provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Structures of one county from the USA Structures hosted view (USA_Structures_View layer 0 on services2.arcgis.com), as attribute rows without geometry. Segment key: five-digit county FIPS (indexed), optional OCC_CLS filter (indexed; e.g. Residential). Keyset pagination on OBJECTID, up to 2,000 rows per page (`page_size`), ordered by OBJECTID. The first page also returns the segment's total_count. The cursor pins the view's dataLastEditDate (publication_id) and the segment; every page re-reads the layer metadata and, if the view has been republished since the cursor was issued, fails with invalid_input issue code `publication_changed` instead of mixing vintages. Rows carry source_record_id (ORNL UUID), objectid, publication_id, source_url and retrieved_at plus the mapped fields (BUILD_ID, OCC_CLS, PRIM_OCC, SEC_OCC, PROP_* address, FIPS, STATE_FIPS, CENSUSCODE tract, LONGITUDE/LATITUDE centroid in WGS 84, SQFEET, SQMETERS, HEIGHT, OUTBLDG, IMAGE_DATE, IMAGE_NAME, PROD_DATE, SOURCE, VAL_METHOD, POP_*, B_CODE, USNG, GlobalID). The view's data currency (June 2025) is older than the 2026 state files; see `view`. CENSUSCODE and UUID are not indexed upstream and are not offered as filters.

The response contains the tool result directly.

include_fgdc.description: Read the FGDC metadata XML from inside the zip with S3 range reads (publication date, imagery dates, constraints). Requires `state`.

state.description: USPS code (PR, AK, TX) or name (Puerto Rico) of one state or territory. Omit for all 56 rows of the hub table.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Cheap version check of the USA Structures publication. Reads the hub downloads page (portal item data) for the current state zip link of every state and territory (56 rows; the bucket listing omits current files, so the page is authoritative), HEADs each zip on the public S3 bucket for size, ETag (multipart MD5, the publisher's only posted hash), x-amz-version-id and Last-Modified, derives the release date from the file name (PR_Structures_20260913 -> 2026-09-13; Deliverable20250606TX -> 2025-06-06), and reports the hosted view's dataLastEditDate as the records publication id. With `state` set, adds the view's row count for that state; with `include_fgdc` (one state only) two or three S3 range reads parse the zip central directory and the embedded FGDC metadata XML (publication date, imagery date range, access and use constraints). Every state file exceeds the 32 MiB fetch cap (only the small territories AS, GU, MP, VI and DC fit), so `handoff` is true for them: download the file_url out of band and use records_list for rows.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `states` as the primary payload key.

handoff.note: A state zip with handoff=true exceeds the 32 MiB runner fetch cap (every state; only the small territories AS, GU, MP, VI and DC fit) and every zip holds the feature table as one deflate entry, so records are never read from the files: download the file_url out of band (ETag and x-amz-version-id identify the object; Range is supported) and use records_list for row access on the hosted view.
